svg.title: The two passes of the conflict check
svg.desc: Pass 1 lists, for every group, the paths it wrote and deleted, without reading a file. If a write of one group meets a deletion of another, that is a conflict. If no path is written by more than one group, the groups are independent. Otherwise pass 2 hashes only those paths, in only those groups: the same content, mode and owner everywhere means independent, anything else is a conflict.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 240px; text-align: center;
